title: GTA6 Launch Trailer Reportedly Skipping PS5's New QSSR Upscaler
description: Sony's new QSSR upscaler for base PS5 sparks speculation regarding GTA6, but gaming media Push Square suggests the launch trailer won't feature it.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Intersection of GTA6 and Sony's New QSSR Upscaler

Sony recently introduced QSSR, bringing a version of the PS5 Pro’s acclaimed PSSR upscaler to base PS5 hardware. Described as "quite extravagant," this technology has immediately sparked speculation across the gaming community, with many wondering if its rollout was timed specifically to coincide with the launch of Rockstar Games' highly anticipated GTA6.

However, according to insights from gaming media outlet Push Square, it is unlikely that we are seeing this new technology implemented in the current promotional materials for GTA6. While Sony has made QSSR available to third-party developers, the technology has currently only been incorporated into first-party titles such as *Marvel’s Wolverine* and *Ghost of Yotei*. 

### Technical Implications for Open-World Giants

The introduction of QSSR to base hardware represents a significant step for console graphics, aiming to bridge the gap between standard and pro hardware capabilities. For a massive open-world project like GTA6, advanced upscaling and rendering techniques are crucial. Even so, whether Rockstar will integrate QSSR into GTA6 remains a subject of ongoing industry speculation rather than confirmed fact.

### Editor's Take
While the timing of Sony's QSSR rollout naturally invites speculation about a partnership or alignment with GTA6, players should keep expectations grounded. Rockstar is known for developing proprietary engine pipelines and optimization methods. Whether or not QSSR plays a role in GTA6's final technical makeup, the game's visual ambitions will undoubtedly push hardware limits on all platforms.
